newsitem.title: USA: NACCO Industries tender auction results.
newsitem.headline: NACCO Industries tender auction results.

text.p: NACCO Industries Inc said on Monday it purchased 800,000 shares of its class A common stock at a price of $50 per share under its Dutch tender offer, which expired December 16.
This was about 11 percent of the outstanding Class A stock, the company said.

Of the 272,831 shares of Class A common stock tendered pursuant to guaranteed delivery, 271,331 shares were physically delivered to the despositary, NACCO said. There was a 95.03 percent proration factor, it said.
NACCO said it began the offer on November 18 for the purchase of up to 800,000 shares of Class A Common Stock at a purchase price not less than $43.50 and not greater than $50 per share.
